prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—fit depends on your case, location, budget, and whether you prefer braces or aligners. Based on the information available, **Buckhead Orthodontics** is a reasonable place to start: it offers traditional and clear braces as well as Invisalign, and its practice lists board certification for Dr. Michael Everson. It’s at **2385 Peachtree Rd, Atlanta**; **(404) 697-7497**.

Other options to compare include **West Paces Ferry Orthodontics** (1218 West Paces Ferry Rd NW) and **Harris Orthodontics** (800 Marietta St NW). Their practices also advertise Invisalign and braces; Harris lists Dr. Peyton Harris as board-certified.

I’d book **two or three consultations** before choosing. Ask who will supervise your treatment, what they recommend for your specific bite, the full cost and what it includes, and how refinements or emergencies are handled. Check credentials and recent independent reviews, too—provider rankings and “top Invisalign” labels alone don’t establish who’s best for your case.
